usage: codepro [-h] [--version] {doctor,inspect,run,baseline-cost} ...

Deterministic CLI boundary for the CodePro software-engineering chassis.

positional arguments:
  {doctor,inspect,run,baseline-cost}
    doctor              Check whether the local Python runtime can execute the
                        current chassis.
    inspect             Inspect the current project without changing it.
    run                 Run one authorized, bounded executor command and
                        declared verifier.
    baseline-cost       Measure local overhead without changing behavior.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
